status_meaning.MASTERNODE: In the masternode set for the current epoch (from the epoch switch block header).
status_meaning.STANDBY: A candidate with stake that is not in the current masternode set.
status_meaning.SLASHED: Penalised at the current epoch switch (listed in the block header's penalties).

governance_note: The governance object on each candidate comes from the XDC governance dApp API (https://master.apothem.network/api): the last block the node signed, as seen by that site's crawler, the data centre registered there. not_signing_recently means a MASTERNODE has not signed for more than 1800 blocks (about an hour); it is left out when that site's data looks out of date. The governance site numbers epochs by block number, which differs from the XDPoS 2.0 epoch numbers (by consensus round) used everywhere in this feed.
history_note: history_7d / history_30d on each candidate count epochs recorded by this feed in the last 7 / 30 UTC days ending on the most recent recorded day: epochs it was an eligible masternode and epochs it was slashed. They fill up as the feed runs, or after a backfill.

owner_concentration.note: Fewest owner addresses that together hold more than 1/3 (or 1/2) of masternode seats. One organisation may use several owner addresses, so real concentration can be higher.
